posts.title: Why Coherence Doesn't Scale with Capability
posts.description: There's a quiet assumption underneath most AI discussions: if capability keeps improving, coherence will eventually follow. Gödel's incompleteness theorems suggest otherwise. The supervision layer isn't a temporary workaround — it's part of the design.

posts.title: Why AI Needs Control Surfaces, Not Just Chat
posts.description: Once you can see what the system is doing, the next problem is interacting with it. Chat interfaces for AI agents are like flying a drone through a text terminal. The industry needs purpose-built control surfaces.

posts.title: Observability for AI Agents
posts.description: AI systems fail in ways that look like success. You can't find these failures in a chat log. You need traces. AI agent systems need the same observability infrastructure that distributed systems built over the past decade.
